messages:
meera: Heads up — during the keystore rotation in eu-west-1 we saw ~30% of new GPU pods stuck in Pending. kube-scheduler logs show bind failures and conntrack exhaustion. Also seeing audit-shipper 503s to central-collector.
jon: Are KMS decrypt errors showing up on node init or later?
devin: Looks like node init hits KMS 401 transiently, then backoff; the retry storms plus our autoscaler window seem to be saturating conntrack. Window ~10:03-10:12 UTC. :eyes:
meera: Confirmed. Warm pool nodes were cycling and kubelet was dropping new pods once conntrack hit limit.
devin: Did we deploy the tighter outbound firewall/rate-limit to collector yesterday? I thought the permit for shipper was staged but not live. @net-eng?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling-keystore-rotation started eu-west-1 az-a at 10:00 UTC
harper: If shippers queue locally we risk retention overflow — how long can they buffer before we lose events? If >1h we need fallback.
security-ryan: We purposely tightened SNI/TLS checks on collector to avoid accepting forged traffic. For rotations we can allow a temporary fallback to the s3-proxy path, or a short collector allowlist. Prefer allowlist for 20-30m windows with ephemeral creds/audit.
jon: Cost tradeoff: keeping extra warm nodes to avoid cold-starts during rotation costs ~ $0.35/node/hr. Alternative is to stagger rotations per AZ with 15m offsets to smooth KMS QPS and collector load.
meera: We did stagger, but cron windows overlapped with autoscaler reconcilers and the fleet rebalancer — which ended up shifting most pending pods into a single AZ once taints were removed. That created a concentrated spike.
devin: Quick mitigation we can push: increase conntrack on warm nodes via sysctl. Rolling DaemonSet to set net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max to 262144 may buy time.

sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144

harper: We can ship that as a FleetConfig patch to warm nodes, but infra-sig approval needed since it's a kernel-level change.
security-ryan: If we open collector egress temporarily, require ephemeral creds + HSM-signed rotation and full audit. I can sign off for a 30m window if a ticket is created and we log the allowlist changes.
meera: Action list: (1) devin — prod-apply conntrack bump (10m), (2) jon — stagger remainder of keystore rotations by 15m, (3) security-ryan — provision 30m collector allowlist and post-rotation HSM rotation plan. I'll own the incident doc/postmortem.
devin: On it. Rolling conntrack bump to warm pools now. Will update in ~5. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: conntrack-daemonset rollout started 10:18 UTC
meera: Quick check: pending pods dropped from ~120 -> 8 after conntrack bump, collector 503s reduced. Monitoring for 30m to confirm stability.
harper: Also adding a temporary autoscaler cap to avoid hot rescaling while rotation finishes.
meera: Thanks team. I'll create postmortem draft in #postmortems and link the ticket (INC-3587654321).
